            then json_build_object('returned', s.n, 'keys', s.keys, 'skipped_checked', c.keys)
            else ('s721d piles rollback guard: the UPDATE matched ' || s.n || ' rows, the plan names ' || (e.expect - c.n))::int::text::json end as returned
  from s, c, e;
